question: Should CodexBar adopt a permanent privacy-first local usage-card export, with every visible account included but no account identity exposed?
rationale: VISION.md requires sign-off for new product surfaces, and code correctness work should follow the chosen permanent account-scope contract rather than establish it implicitly.

options.title: Approve account-complete export
options.body: Keep the draft open, require identity-free aggregation across every visible account, regression coverage, and inspectable bundled-app proof before merge.

options.title: Decline the sharing surface
options.body: Close the draft without landing new menu or Settings export UI if shareable cards are outside CodexBar's intended control-surface scope.

recommendation.title: Approve account-complete export
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open, require identity-free aggregation across every visible account, regression coverage, and inspectable bundled-app proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository product direction and the prior multi-account implementation were merged through this owner.
